title: Multimodal Approaches to Fair Image Classification: An Ethical Perspective

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating zero-shot image classification accuracy across specific racial categories (4-group and 7-group classifications like White, Black, Asian, Latino) using the IdenProf dataset, measuring how synthetic image generation with race-specific prompts offsets performance disparities.

Comparing zero-shot image classification top-1 accuracy between male and female subjects by appending gender descriptors to text prompts and generating gender-specific synthetic reference images to observe performance improvements.

Measuring zero-shot image classification accuracy across 9 distinct age brackets (e.g., 0-2, 30-39, 70+) by incorporating age descriptors into synthetic data generation prompts and evaluating the classification outcomes.
